name: paper-lantern-research-mcp
description: Local MCP tools for managing a Paper Lantern literature library.

interface.shortDescription: MCP tools for Paper Lantern papers and notes.
interface.longDescription: Adds local MCP tools for importing paper PDFs into multiple categories, adding and removing category memberships, searching by multiple categories, writing notes and reports, and generating Paper Lantern paper links.
defaultPrompt: Import this paper into Paper Lantern.
Create a Paper Lantern research note.
Make links to papers in my library.
